Gold Dagger 2026

Kevin Anderson Associates

Winner

Abigail Dean

The Death of Us

Published by: HarperCollins - Hemlock Press

  • Website
  • Buy online
  • Instagram

Judges’ comments

A tense and unflinching story of the aftermath of violent crime. The novel shifts between timelines, examining the effects on a couple over the years between the incident and the upcoming trial of their attacker, showing that the violence and violation never truly ended for them. It’s an outstanding examination of the effects of trauma, and the power of love.
